# eAI

> llms.txt for the eAI repository (embeddedos-org/eAI).
> Status: the AI layer for EmbeddedOS — on-device inference
> runtime, model handling, and the Track 1 tightly-coupled AI
> design work (accelerator HAL, silicon roster, runtime API).

eAI is the intelligence layer of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem: the
inference runtime and AI services that eos, eosllm, eNI and eApps
build on, designed for constrained devices (arena allocation,
power-aware model selection) rather than ported from the cloud.
